53:27.text: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

53:28.text: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and verily, guess is no substitute for the truth.

53:29.text: from him who turns away from Our Reminder
and desires nothing but the life of this world.

53:30.text: That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord it is He Who knows best him who goes astray from His Path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.

53:31.text: And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done
, and reward those who do good, with what is best

53:32.text: except the small faults, - verily, your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth
, and when you were fetuses in your mothers’ wombs. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who fears Allâh and keeps his duty to Him
[i.e. those who are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)]

53:34.text: And gave a little, then stopped

53:35.text: Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

53:36.text: Or is he not informed with what is in the Pages

53:37.text: (Allâh ordered him to do or convey)

53:39.text: And that man can have nothing but what he does

53:40.text: And that his deeds will be seen.

53:41.text: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.

53:44.text: Who causes death and gives life.
